newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Echo Bay view revised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Echo Bay view revised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it revised its estimates on Echo Bay Mines Ltd to a loss of $0.38 from a loss of $0.51 for 1997, to a loss of $0.28 from a loss of $0.41 for 1998 and to a profit of $0.04 from a loss of $0.10 for 1999.

--EVEREN said it acted on the company's announcement it was planning to bring two new mines into production by year-end 1998. Echo Bay also said it plans to discontinue common stock dividends. EVEREN said this was "a move we view favorable given that the company is entering a period of intense development and capital expenditure."
--Echo Bay was trading at 6-1/4, off 1/8 on the American Stock Exchange.
